integrity: Mathematical statements and cited claims are distinguished from independent validation; all finite program checks are reproducible with Python 3 standard library.
scientific_limitations: Exact result concerns a real two-column rank-one input, unbiased {0,1} rounding with common entry mean p, iid rows and arbitrary within-row Bernoulli coupling; singular-value statements are asymptotic almost surely. Historical equivalent occupancy/design results might exist. No independent audit conducted. Varying p means varying the input matrix; for each fixed p both criteria prefer the minimum feasible q.
title: Sharp coupled-rounding rank recovery and opposing spectral optimum for duplicate columns
